subject: Warning about P_WAIC when using LOO

messages.author: 3b39c2c6f6822668
messages.subject: Warning about P_WAIC when using LOO
parts:
When calling blavFitIndices(), I am getting a warning about p_waic estimates and a recommendation to try loo. I'm confused because I had set pD = "loo". Am I misunderstanding something or is this warning a false positive?

blavFitIndices(
  fit1,
  baseline.model = fit0,
  pD = "loo",
  rescale = "devM",
  fit.measures = "all"
)

#> 7 (7.3%) p_waic estimates greater than 0.4. We recommend trying loo instead.
#> 96 (100.0%) p_waic estimates greater than 0.4. We recommend trying loo instead.Some Pareto k diagnostic values are too high. See help('pareto-k-diagnostic') for details.
#>
#> 6 (6.2%) p_waic estimates greater than 0.4. We recommend trying loo instead.

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Warning about P_WAIC when using LOO
parts:
Jeffrey

That is correct, this is a false positive warning. It happens because we use the fitMeasures() function in the process. This estimates both the p_waic and p_loo. So, it shows those warnings

A small recommendation, save this output in an object to be able to use the summary functions, etc

fit_mcmc <- blavFitIndices(

fit1,
  baseline.model = fit0,
  pD = "loo",
  rescale = "devM",
  fit.measures = "all"
